words.defn_en: watchful:

sentences.en: Parents should remain ______ when their children are near the swimming pool.
sentences.zh: 當孩子靠近游泳池時,家長應該保持警惕。

sentences.en: The guards stayed ______ throughout the night, watching for any sign of trouble.
sentences.zh: 警衛整晚保持警惕,留意任何可能發生問題的跡象。

words.defn_en: wakeful watching:

sentences.en: Family members kept a ______ at the hospital all night.
sentences.zh: 家屬整夜都在醫院守候。

sentences.en: Hundreds gathered for a candlelight ______ to honor the victims.
sentences.zh: 數百人聚集舉行燭光守夜,以悼念這些受害者。

words.defn_en: lively:

sentences.en: Her ______ personality made her the life of every party.
sentences.zh: 她活潑開朗的個性讓她成為每場派對的靈魂人物。

sentences.en: The ______ young actress charmed the entire audience.
sentences.zh: 這位活潑生動的年輕女演員迷倒了全場觀眾。

words.defn_en: sociable, outgoing, especially when pertaining to eating and drinking; fond of good company

sentences.en: The dinner party had a ______ atmosphere filled with laughter.
sentences.zh: 這場晚宴洋溢著充滿歡笑的歡樂氣氛。

sentences.en: He enjoyed the ______ company of old friends over a bottle of wine.
sentences.zh: 他喜歡與老朋友一邊喝酒,一邊享受歡樂的相聚時光。

words.defn_en: a person who enjoys good food, drink, and company:
words.defn_zh: 享樂主義者;講究生活享受的人

sentences.en: As a true ______ , he never turned down an invitation to a fine dinner.
sentences.zh: 身為一位真正懂得享受生活的人,他從不拒絕任何一場美食盛宴的邀約。

sentences.en: The travel show followed a charming ______ sampling wine across the countryside.
sentences.zh: 這個旅遊節目跟拍了一位迷人的生活享受家,在鄉間品嚐各種葡萄酒。

words.defn_en: made or effective between living persons, especially of a legal transfer:
words.defn_zh: 生前的;生者之間的(法律用語)

sentences.en: The estate was distributed through an ______ trust.
sentences.zh: 這份遺產是透過生前信託分配的。

sentences.en: An ______ gift avoids certain estate taxes after death.
sentences.zh: 生前贈與能避免死後某些遺產稅。

words.defn_en: to give strength or energy to:

sentences.en: A cold shower can ______ you first thing in the morning.
sentences.zh: 一場冷水澡能在早晨第一時間讓你精神振奮。

sentences.en: The team's win seemed to ______ the entire town.
sentences.zh: 這支隊伍的勝利似乎讓整座小鎮充滿了活力。

words.defn_en: making one feel stronger and more energetic:

sentences.en: The mountain air felt wonderfully ______ .
sentences.zh: 山間的空氣讓人感到十分振奮清爽。

sentences.en: She found the debate ______ rather than exhausting.
sentences.zh: 她覺得這場辯論令人振奮,而非疲憊。

words.defn_en: to restore to life, consciousness, or vigor:
words.root_note: revivere (to live again), from Latin re- (again) + vivere (to live)

sentences.en: Paramedics worked quickly to ______ the unconscious patient.
sentences.zh: 醫護人員迅速搶救,使這位失去意識的病人甦醒過來。

sentences.en: The festival helped ______ interest in the town's forgotten history.
sentences.zh: 這場慶典幫助重振了人們對這座城鎮被遺忘歷史的興趣。

words.defn_en: giving new life or vigor to something:
words.root_note: re- (again) + vivificare (to make alive), from Latin vivus (living) + facere (to make)

sentences.en: The rain brought a ______ freshness to the withered garden.
sentences.zh: 這場雨為這座枯萎的花園帶來了恢復生機的清新。

sentences.en: Their trip abroad had a truly ______ effect on her outlook.
sentences.zh: 他們的海外旅行對她的人生觀產生了真正恢復生機的效果。

words.defn_en: the action of keeping careful watch:

sentences.en: Constant ______ is needed for security.
sentences.zh: 維護安全需要持續的警覺。

sentences.en: Parents must maintain ______ when their children are near water.
sentences.zh: 當孩子靠近水域時,父母必須保持高度警覺。

words.defn_en: a person who takes law enforcement into their own hands without legal authority:
words.defn_zh: 自警團成員;私刑執法者
words.root_note: vigilante (watchman), from Spanish, from Latin vigilare (to keep watch)

sentences.en: The film centers on a masked ______ fighting crime at night.
sentences.zh: 這部電影的核心是一位戴著面具、在夜間打擊犯罪的私刑執法者。

sentences.en: Local authorities warned against forming ______ groups to punish suspects.
sentences.zh: 當地政府警告不要組成私刑團體來懲罰嫌疑人。

words.defn_en: a brief, evocative description or episode; a decorative border design:
words.root_note: vignette (a small vine design), from French vigne (vine)

sentences.en: The book consists of short ______ s depicting everyday rural life.
sentences.zh: 這本書由描繪日常鄉村生活的短篇小品文組成。

sentences.en: The film's opening ______ sets the tone for the rest of the story.
sentences.zh: 這部電影開場的小插曲為故事其餘的部分定下了基調。

words.defn_en: strong, healthy, and full of energy:

sentences.en: He maintained a ______ exercise routine well into his eighties.
sentences.zh: 他直到八十多歲仍維持著精力充沛的運動習慣。

sentences.en: The debate turned into a ______ exchange of opposing views.
sentences.zh: 這場辯論演變成一場針鋒相對、活力十足的意見交流。

words.defn_en: the quality of being lively and animated:
words.root_note: vivacitas, from Latin vivax (lively), from vivere (to live)

sentences.en: Her ______ made her the center of attention at every party.
sentences.zh: 她的活潑生動讓她在每場派對上都成為眾人矚目的焦點。

sentences.en: The child's natural ______ delighted everyone in the room.
sentences.zh: 這個孩子天生的活潑生氣讓房間裡的每個人都感到欣喜。

words.defn_en: producing powerful feelings or clear images in the mind:

sentences.en: She gave a ______ description of the sunset over the ocean.
sentences.zh: 她生動地描述了海洋上空的日落景色。

sentences.en: He still had ______ memories of his childhood home.
sentences.zh: 他對自己童年的家依然保有鮮明的記憶。

words.defn_en: to give life or vigor to; to animate:
words.root_note: vivificare, from Latin vivus (alive) + facere (to make)

sentences.en: The author's rich details ______ every scene in the novel.
sentences.zh: 這位作者豐富的細節讓這本小說裡的每一個場景都栩栩如生。

sentences.en: Fresh flowers seemed to ______ the otherwise dull room.
sentences.zh: 新鮮的花朵彷彿為這個原本沉悶的房間注入了生機。

words.defn_en: giving birth to live offspring rather than laying eggs:
words.root_note: vivus (alive) + parere (to bring forth), from Latin

sentences.en: Most mammals are ______ , giving birth to fully formed young.
sentences.zh: 大多數哺乳動物都是胎生的,會產下發育完全的幼崽。

sentences.en: Some species of sharks are surprisingly ______ rather than egg-laying.
sentences.zh: 某些鯊魚物種出人意料地是胎生的,而非卵生。

words.defn_en: surgical experimentation on live animals for scientific research:

sentences.en: Animal rights groups protested against the lab's use of ______ .
sentences.zh: 動物權利團體抗議這間實驗室進行活體解剖。

sentences.en: The university phased out ______ in favor of alternative methods.
sentences.zh: 這所大學逐步淘汰活體解剖,改採替代方法。

words.defn_en: the act of burying someone alive:

sentences.en: The horror novel's plot centers on the terrifying fear of ______ .
sentences.zh: 這本恐怖小說的情節圍繞著活埋這種令人恐懼的主題展開。

sentences.en: Historical accounts occasionally describe accidental cases of ______ before modern medicine.
sentences.zh: 在現代醫學出現之前,歷史記載偶爾會描述意外活埋的案例。
